summary.document_scope: Three chapters, each a 'Family register' with a single genealogy table and a marginal note per chapter. All tables have the same structure except chapter-002.html, which fuses BOY/GIRL columns into one.
summary.default_note_policy: Marginal or aside notes about children are attached to the relevant person via a data-person attribute, not placed in the main table. BOY and GIRL columns are to be kept separate, not fused.
summary.default_note_policy_rationale: The majority of chapters (2 out of 3) use separate BOY and GIRL columns and attach child notes as marginal/aside content, not as table rows or cells. This is the dominant and most internally consistent pattern.

pattern_conventions.label: Standard family register with separate BOY and GIRL columns

document_local_conventions.subgroup_context_rows: Not used; all rows are standard person entries.
document_local_conventions.table_fragmentation: Not present; one table per chapter.
document_local_conventions.marginal_or_handwritten_notes: Handled as asides with data-person attribute, not as table rows or cells.
